_SETUP_REQUIRED: Fill in real slot numbers from TotalMix Quick Select before use, then copy this file to ufx2_snapshot_map.json in the state dir (repo root from source or Docker, %APPDATA%/tmosc-bridge when installed). A copy mounted at /app/config/ufx2_snapshot_map.json takes precedence and hot-reloads. tools/scrape_totalmix_snapshots.* can generate it.
